selection.reason: Introduce Git-based evidence exchange and credential-free public inspection while retaining acceptance for the outstanding specification tooling. Keep every previously selected module and all planned paths. Preserve rejected execution attempts and the original 300-second delivery budget through verified publication. Require complete category outcomes, independent source assessment and existing publication admission; add no automatic regression category or paid fallback.

spec.title: SSH evidence exchange and guarded publication
acceptance: Export must verify approved command coverage and local source identities before constructing a repeatable evidence object. Use constant synthetic commit metadata, exactly one source parent, one regular validation payload, and a payload digest; update its dedicated remote reference with an explicit observed-value lease and verify the advertised result. Authenticated CLI calls and obsolete status writes must be absent.

Import from a fresh repository must verify reproducible object identity, exact parent and source tree, entry name and mode, bounded payload, digest, repository scope, owner scope and command contract. Missing, redirected, malformed or altered evidence must grant zero coverage and leave required commands executable by CI.

The default metadata reader must restrict requests to bodyless GET operations at the designated GitHub API origin, omit credentials, reject redirects, and enforce byte and duration limits. Invalid destinations, write methods, HTTP failures and malformed responses must fail explicitly.

CI admission must retain repository, source, workflow, event, attempt and unique required-job checks. Discover watched references through Git, create them only with an absent-value lease, reject conflicts, and report an unavailable rerun as a retained failure with actionable run identification. Preparation must produce no publication descriptor before qualifying CI succeeds.

Publication must use the prepared destination and explicit expected remote object, including an empty expectation for a new reference. Concurrent remote movement must fail without updating the destination; ancestry checks, current native decisions, preparation custody and effective hooks must remain enforced.

Retain the existing envelope schema and sanitized execution provenance. Damaged originals, missing independent approval and unsupported historical qualifications must prevent export; read-only CI access must suffice for import, and unavailable imported evidence must never manufacture a passing command result.

The revised feature contract must admit the complete planned range and bind its design, plan, modules and fixtures. Category execution must require complete successful results without skipped cases; prior refusals and original timing must remain truthful, and no fail-before success may be inferred from an admission error.

Specification verification must preserve canonical digest parity, strict structures, public-text privacy, exact base and scope association, and complete acceptance-to-module mapping. Missing, damaged or mismatched seals must stop executable release admission before validation begins.

Proposal adapters must preserve explicit engine selection, truthful model identity, bounded restricted execution, verified external-input custody and refusal without fallback when unavailable. Both supported adapters must generate the sealed selection against the fetched main baseline.

Integrated review behavior must retain original execution outcomes, supported policy producer checks, resumable coverage and independent current-source decisions. Process errors and stale evidence must supply no technical approval or deployment authority.

Maintained implementation and shipping instructions must agree across their mirrors on Git evidence exchange, public-reader limitations, manual failed-run recovery and leased publication. SSH identity configuration must remain local, exclude private key material from artifacts and introduce no sibling source dependency.

tests.purpose: Verify feature selection, scope admission, design bindings and complete category result requirements.
Verify integrated range admission, early seal enforcement, artifact boundaries and uncovered-command execution.
Verify envelope integrity, original execution custody, command qualification and precise CI admission.
Verify preparation ordering, decision custody, destination expectations and publication hooks.
Verify native review continuity, evidence applicability and truthful failure handling.
Verify accepted producer identities and retained policy rejection behavior.
Exercise real Git evidence exchange, hostile payloads, bounded public requests and concurrent reference updates.
Verify canonical sealing against the synthetic vector, structural constraints, privacy and contract association.
Verify adapter dispatch, restriction settings, external evidence custody and baseline requirements.
Verify complete proposal generation through both adapters and agreement among maintained implementation instructions.

findings.message: Evidence acceptance relies on the repository writer set. Deterministic object reconstruction proves content integrity but supplies no individual writer identity. Activation requires independently verified authority covering that credential-trust effect; technical approval grants no additional authority.
